subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should OpenClaw officially support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth for native OpenAI `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, rather than keep batch STT API-key-only?
rationale: The branch changes a compatibility-sensitive provider credential contract; current main and official endpoint examples are API-key-oriented, so code review cannot safely infer the intended billing, entitlement, and support policy.

options.title: Adopt OAuth-backed native batch STT
options.body: Accept OAuth only for validated native OpenAI endpoints, require a successful final-head live transcription, and document the supported credential and precedence rules.

options.title: Keep batch STT API-key-only
options.body: Retain the existing guard and close this direction in favor of clear validation and documentation for OAuth-profile audio configurations.

recommendation.title: Adopt OAuth-backed native batch STT
recommendation.body: Accept OAuth only for validated native OpenAI endpoints, require a successful final-head live transcription, and document the supported credential and precedence rules.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom merged the related audio-auth policy change and is the strongest history-based routing candidate for this contract decision.
